plugins.name: vitrinka
plugins.description: Screenshot journeys, annotation boards, and the AI expression layer — 13 skills in three modules: core (publish = captured work [session·journey·walkthrough·board], artifact = authored [standalone·pages·diagram·docs board], brainstorming, listen, resolve, answers, annotations), PM (tasks, release) and QA (sessions, pair, usertest, review). Modules are presets over Claude Code's skillOverrides via `vitrinka skills`; the vitrinka MCP server is registered separately by `vitrinka install` (secret-free stdio forwarder).
